propositions: Eight empty, uncommitted directories exist in the tickets tracker without corresponding CREATE events, each flagged by fsck as MISSING_CREATE and FOREIGN_STORE_PATH.
All eight directories are confirmed empty, uncommitted, non-existent by rebar, with no open file handles, and mtimes older than 30 minutes, indicating debris from processes interrupted mid-write.

rebar tracker-maintenance --clean must execute an all-or-nothing sweep deleting exactly the eight triaged foreign directories only if a pre-sweep --status check confirms the foreign list matches precisely those eight ids.

After successful --clean execution, fsck issues must drop from 16 to 7 with all MISSING_CREATE and FOREIGN_STORE_PATH findings eliminated, while committed ticket data (HEAD ref and git status) remain unchanged.

The sweep is bounded by five per-directory guards (empty, uncommitted, non-existent, no open handles, mtime > 30min) and a run-level equality gate to prevent deletion of any unintended or newly-written directories.
